answer: Sequential work-proof admission requires each identity to earn a verified raven by solving non-parallelizable VDF checkpoints audited by a challenger forge. When the forge detects shared payout ancestry or identical state-roots across $k$ accounts, it merges them onto one tundra and scales the required sequential checkpoints per new identity to $k^2$ consecutive epochs. A solo newcomer spends 1 epoch of continuous compute to claim its raven, whereas an operator deploying $k$ sybils on a shared tundra must burn $k(k+1)(2k+1)/6$ sequential epochs of judged work across the forge.
